column2: Poisoning Attacks on LLMs Require a Near-constant Number of Poison Samples
column6: Empirical finding: ~250 poisoned documents suffice to backdoor models 600M-13B regardless of dataset size; largest pretraining poisoning experiments to date (joint with Anthropic/Turing).

column2: Inoculation Prompting: Eliciting traits from LLMs during training can suppress them at test-time
column6: Empirical methodology finding with measured results (reduces emergent misalignment, backdoor injection, subliminal trait transmission; arXiv 2510.04340); AISI-affiliated authors; not in dataset - candidate miss.

column2: Do chatbots inform or misinform voters?
column6: Blog restating findings of the primary study arXiv 2509.05219 (UKAISI-2025-09), already covered via the 2025-09-08 research page and paper.

column2: How we're working with frontier AI developers to improve model security
column6: Partnership announcement about voluntary collaborations with Anthropic/OpenAI; no measured results, vulnerability counts, or documented evaluation outcomes.

column2: Conversational AI increases political knowledge as effectively as self-directed internet search
column6: Empirical findings: 32% of UK chatbot users sought political info (N=2499 survey); RCTs (N=2858) show AI increases political knowledge as much as internet search; primary research page for arXiv 2509.05219.

column2: Lessons from studying two-hop latent reasoning
column6: Empirical finding: models fail to compose two synthetic facts but succeed when one fact is natural (Llama 3 8B, GPT-4o; arXiv 2411.16353); AISI co-authored; not in dataset - candidate miss.

column2: From bugs to bypasses: adapting vulnerability disclosure for AI safeguards
column6: Framework/proposal piece with NCSC on adapting vulnerability disclosure to AI safeguards; no evidence-backed results.

column2: Managing risks from increasingly capable open-weight AI systems
column6: Matches dataset report UKAISI-2025-08-29 (same URL); contains qualifying governance/risk findings on open-weight systems asserted by AISI.

column2: Deep ignorance: Filtering pretraining data builds tamper-resistant safeguards into open-weight LLMs
column6: Empirical finding: pretraining data filtering yields tamper-resistant safeguards in open-weight LLMs (with EleutherAI; arXiv 2508.06601); research page for dataset report UKAISI-2025-08.

column2: The Inspect Sandboxing Toolkit: Scalable and secure AI agent evaluations
column6: Open-source tool release announcement (Docker Compose/Kubernetes/Proxmox plugins); no measured results or evaluation outcomes.

column2: Announcing the Alignment Project: A global fund of over £15 million for AI alignment research
column6: Funding announcement for a £15m+ alignment research fund; no findings.

column2: Security challenges in AI agent deployment: Insights from a large scale public competition
column6: Empirical findings from largest public agent red-teaming competition (1.8M prompt injections, universal policy violations); matches dataset report UKAISI-2025-07-AUT1 (same URL).

column2: Navigating the uncharted: Building societal resilience to frontier AI
column6: Mission-statement/plan piece for the Societal Resilience Team; prospective work areas only, no evidence-backed findings.

column2: STACK: Adversarial attacks on LLM safeguard pipelines
column6: Empirical finding: staged attack defeats layered safeguard pipelines (arXiv 2506.24068); matches dataset report UKAISI-2025-07-JAI1 (title/date match).

column2: The levers of political persuasion with conversational AI
column6: Empirical persuasion findings from large-scale experiments; matches dataset report UKAISI-2025-07-PERSUADE (same URL).

column2: International joint testing exercise: Agentic testing
column6: Blog summarising the joint International Network evaluation report (primary: PDF hosted on peren.gouv.fr, in dataset as UKAISI-2025-07-CYB1); no findings unique to the blog.

column2: A structured protocol for elicitation experiments
column6: Methodology/process finding incl. 5-20x compute-equivalent elicitation gains; matches dataset report UKAISI-2025-07-GOV1 (same URL).

column2: Chain of thought monitorability: A new and fragile opportunity for AI safety
column6: Multi-org position paper (OpenAI/GDM/Anthropic/AISI et al.) arguing for preserving CoT monitorability; recommendations and survey of existing evidence, no new evidence-backed finding asserted by AISI.
